title: A simpler evidence upload flow
details: The top-right Evidence shortcut has been replaced by the learner's current Target
The centre QR menu now includes Upload evidence beneath Share QR code and Receive QR code
Upload evidence opens a guided Evidence hub with Evidence packs and Upload evidence
Learners can save their online portfolio link in Learner details and Evia uses it when Upload evidence is selected
Evidence packs still open the same existing evidence area and download workflow
summary: Targets now sit on the home screen and evidence upload has one clear guided route.
changes: Moved Targets into the top-right home position
Added Upload evidence to the centre exchange menu
Added an online portfolio link to Learner details
Refreshed the complete offline shell to v109
